thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in 5xx/timeouts from production cluster 'us-west-2' detected by error-rate-monitor — 504s + gateway timeouts. p95 jumped from ~200ms to 1.8s, p99 ~4.7s. Deploy ID: deploy_2026_03_15_21:14.

maria: seeing it, thanks. I'm oncall — pulling metrics now.

deploy-bot: Deploy deploy_2026_03_15_21:14 by jess rolled to canary -> 100% prod at 21:14:08. Digest: b8a1c3f.

dan: confirming locally — `curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate` returns `504 Gateway Time-out` intermittently, request id in header: `req_9f3a`.

lee: any change to connection pooling or gateway proxy in that deploy?

jess: the change was a tweak to the request multiplexer and keepalive settings for backend pool. Added a new feature flag to enable higher concurrent streams; limited unit tests only.

maria: ok, quick triage checklist: 1) Is traffic routing healthy? 2) Any backend OOMs? 3) Autoscaler kicking? 4) Rollback window?

alex: customers reporting increased latency on embeddings endpoints — a few support tickets. Not yet customer-facing incident page, but we should assume impact.

maria: running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=gateway` — some gateways in CrashLoop? attaching snippet:
```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
gateway-54f6c8d7b-2k9p8              1/1     Running   0
gateway-54f6c8d7b-bx7j1              0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  3
```

dan: logs from gateway-bx7j1: `Connection pool exhausted: no available backend` and repeated `upstream request timed out after 5s`.

lee: looks like new multiplexer setting might be draining connections faster or not handing them back. Could be connection leak.

jess: that flag toggles `enable_strict_streaming` which changes how we manage KV cache flushing — possible regression.

maria: customers affected? alex, any list?

alex: preliminary: 12 enterprise tenants with high-requests-per-second (RPS) — top 3 customers account for ~37% of errors. No external outage page yet.

maria: signal here is severe and rising. We have >2% 5xx rate platform-wide for last 3 minutes and p99 >4.5s. Rollback recommended to restore SLO. Any objections?

dan: I support rollback. We don't have time for hotpatch.

lee: agree. Create rollback ticket and run rollback procedure. We'll capture logs for root cause post-rollback.

jess: initiating rollback to previous revision deploy_2026_03_15_20:42 (digest a3f5d0b).

maria: runbook reminder: /runbook rollback-deploy (eng-oncall).

maria: issuing rollback command:
```bash
# rollback to previous stable
redwood-deploy rollback --deployment-id deploy_2026_03_15_20:42 --region us-west-2 --reason "p99 latency/timeouts after deploy_2026_03_15_21:14"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started for deploy_2026_03_15_21:14 -> target deploy_2026_03_15_20:42. Rollback job id: rb_67321.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: canary scaled back, traffic shifting to previous version (30% -> 60% -> 100%).

maria: monitoring metrics. Keep logs and sample traces.

lee: checking backend instances — connection pool metrics returning to baseline as rollback progresses. p95 trending down.

incident-bot: Alert resolved: error rate decreased below threshold. p95 back to ~210ms, p99 ~320ms.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. rb_67321 finished at 21:25:04.

maria: :white_check_mark: Immediate mitigation successful. We'll keep incident open for RCA. Please capture flaky traces.

dan: grabbing heap/conn metrics and will dump KV cache stats. Also saving a sample tail of gateway logs for the window 21:12-21:20.

jess: pushed a revert PR to disable `enable_strict_streaming` flag by default and added extra integration test. PR: https://git.redwood/reverts/328 — please review.

alex: customer comms: drafting a proactive note for affected tenants with incident summary and mitigation; include ETA for RCA.

maria: initial customer impact estimate: ~2.8% of total requests during the 9-minute window failed, affecting 12 tenants; internal SLO breach window ~7 minutes. Please include exact numbers in postmortem.

lee: next steps: 1) full trace correlation to identify leak pattern; 2) test the flag in a staging environment with load >= production; 3) create a canary gate that watches connection-pool-util before promoting traffic.

maria: assigning follow-ups: dan -> logs+traces (priority), jess -> revert & integration tests, lee -> canary gating proposal, alex -> customer comms, I'll own postmortem.

jess: noted. Will block the flag behind `gateway.conn_pool_safety` default-off until validated.

maria: thanks team. Closing emergency paging state. We'll paper over with postmortem and a runbook update for this flag area. :memo:

alex: tagging support for follow-ups and legal if any contracts impacted.

maria: summary for timeline (brief): 21:14 deploy -> 21:16 spike starts -> 21:17 pager -> 21:18 triage -> 21:19 rollback initiated -> 21:25 rollback complete -> service restored.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-0315-47. Postmortem owner: maria.

maria: finishing notes: add links to logs and traces into INC ticket, include list of affected tenants and mitigation done. We'll schedule RCA in the morning.

lee: thumbs up. Also will add a check in the console to surface per-route conn-pool usage in real time.

jess: thanks everyone, sorry for the regression — will follow up with stricter rollout checks.

maria: end of urgent actions. Leaving thread for postmortem updates and timeline edits. :slightly_smiling_face:
